143	// authed resolves the request's API key to the member it acts for, or answers 401. Viewers may only read: any other method
144	// answers 403.
145	func (s *Server) authed(h handler) http.HandlerFunc {
146		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
147			token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(r.Header.Get("Authorization"), "Bearer ")
148			if !ok {
149				writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "send an API key as Authorization: Bearer <token>")
150				return
151			}
152			key, ok := s.store.APIKeyByToken(strings.TrimSpace(token))
153			if !ok || key.RevokedAt != nil {
154				writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "unknown or revoked API key")
155				return
156			}
157			m, ok := s.store.Member(key.OrgID, key.UserID)
158			if !ok {
159				writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "the key's owner is no longer a member")
160				return
161			}
162			s.store.TouchAPIKey(key.ID, s.clock.Now())
163			p := auth.Principal{OrgID: key.OrgID, UserID: key.UserID, KeyID: key.ID, Role: m.Role}
164			if r.Method != http.MethodGet && !auth.CanWrite(p.Role) {
165				writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden", "viewers can only read")
166				return
167			}
168			h(w, r, p)
169		}
170	}

182			id := r.Header.Get("X-Request-Id")
183			if !requestIDRe.MatchString(id) {
184				b := make([]byte, 8)
185				_, _ = rand.Read(b)
186				id = "req_" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
187			}
188			w.Header().Set("X-Request-Id", id)
189			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), requestIDKey, id)))
190		})

17	//
18	// Like the real gateway in its default mode, it takes every charge it is asked for: it does not merge repeated requests.
19	type Fake struct {
20		// OnCharge, when set, is called at the start of every Charge, before its outcome is decided. Tests use it to hold a
21		// charge while they do something else. Set it before the fake is used.
22		OnCharge func(ChargeRequest)
23	
24		mu      sync.Mutex
25		calls   []ChargeRequest
26		charges []Charge
27	}

31		Ref string
32		ChargeRequest
33	}

36	func (f *Fake) Charge(ctx context.Context, req ChargeRequest) (ChargeResult, error) {
37		if f.OnCharge != nil {
38			f.OnCharge(req)
39		}
40		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
41			return ChargeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrUnavailable, err)
42		}
43		f.mu.Lock()
44		defer f.mu.Unlock()
45		f.calls = append(f.calls, req)
46		switch pm := req.PaymentMethod; {
47		case pm == "pm_card_declined":
48			return ChargeResult{}, &DeclineError{Code: "card_declined"}
49		case pm == "pm_card_insufficient_funds":
50			return ChargeResult{}, &DeclineError{Code: "insufficient_funds"}
51		case pm == "pm_gateway_down":
52			return ChargeResult{}, ErrUnavailable
53		case !strings.HasPrefix(pm, "pm_"):
54			return ChargeResult{}, &DeclineError{Code: "invalid_payment_method"}
55		}
56		c := Charge{Ref: fmt.Sprintf("ch_%06d", len(f.charges)+1), ChargeRequest: req}
57		f.charges = append(f.charges, c)
58		return ChargeResult{Ref: c.Ref}, nil
59	}

62	func (f *Fake) Calls() []ChargeRequest {
63		f.mu.Lock()
64		defer f.mu.Unlock()
65		return append([]ChargeRequest(nil), f.calls...)
66	}
67	
68	// Charges returns the charges the fake took (the money that moved).
69	func (f *Fake) Charges() []Charge {
70		f.mu.Lock()
